localization.whats_new:
A clearer way to explore and remember your adventures.

• Group sharing is now one simple choice when you join. Shared ticks, ratings and written memories appear together under each member's name.
• Shared memories remain in the group after a member leaves; owners can erase their retained history, and account deletion removes it.
• Photo rows scroll within their cards, keeping the rest of the app in place.
• Groups use six-character join codes.
• A first-use tutorial explains the Me/Group switch and main sections, and can be replayed from Me.
• Back buttons make it easier to return from a region to its country.
• Search all adventures is now a full-size action on the world screen.
• The world dot map has finer detail. Near me has been removed.

Photos remain on your device, with the existing photo export and backup/import tools.
localization.promotional_text: Find memorable places, build your adventure list and keep your travel notes together. Explore classic experiences and optional one-time hidden-gem collections.
localization.description:
Make your next adventure one to remember.

Wayfinder helps you discover real places worth going, save the experiences that interest you and keep track of the ones you have completed. Browse more than 5,300 adventures around the world, with practical context about the experience, indicative costs and the best time to visit.

PLAN YOUR OWN WAY
Explore destinations by continent and country, save a shortlist and organise adventures into trips. Search all adventures from the world screen, or browse destinations manually without sharing your location. Travel warnings remain visible, and destinations marked do not travel are excluded from automatic suggestions.

SHARE WITH A GROUP
When you create or join a group, choose once whether to share eligible adventure ticks, completion dates, star ratings and written memories. Group Memories shows each sharing person’s entries together. Entries already shared remain under your name in that group after you leave; you can erase that saved group history later, and account or group deletion removes it. Your photos, purchases and shortlist do not join group sharing.

KEEP YOUR MEMORIES
Add notes, ratings and photos to your completed adventures. Wayfinder keeps its in-app photo copies on the phone where you add them; it does not automatically upload or sync them. You can choose to save copies to your iPhone or iPad Photos library; your Photos and iCloud settings then govern those copies. You can manually export a password-encrypted photo backup and import it into the same Wayfinder account on another phone. Sign in to the same account to access synced progress; Wayfinder in-app photos appear on another phone only when you deliberately transfer and import the backup files. Previously loaded catalogue content and phone-local memories remain available offline. Keep an independent copy of anything important.

DISCOVER HIDDEN GEMS
Classic adventures are included. Optional one-time purchases unlock hidden-gem guide collections for individual geographic packs or all continents together. The All continents collection also includes Antarctica. Purchases belong to your individual Wayfinder account.

Wayfinder provides discovery and planning information. Some adventures include a clearly labelled paid link to a matching Viator experience. Bookings, payment and cancellation take place with Viator and the provider; RL Applications may earn a commission. Travel, admission, permits, accommodation and guide fees are separate from Wayfinder purchases. Costs and opening or access information can change, so check current information with the relevant venue or authority before travelling.

An account is required. Uninstalling the app or clearing its data can remove phone-local memories that you have not exported.

Developed by RL Applications. Support: help.rlapplications@gmail.com

review_contact.notes:
Wayfinder 1.2 (build 14) contains the latest tested group-memory/navigation improvements. Sign in using the supplied verified Wayfinder demo account; it does not require a new registration or email verification.

The Me/Group button beside the dice changes between personal and group views. Joining or creating a group asks one choice for sharing completion ticks/dates, ratings and written memories. A private choice keeps personal records private. Leaving keeps a frozen named copy of previously shared group history; the owner can erase it, and deleting the account removes it from groups. New edits after leaving do not alter the frozen copy. Group Memories combines each member's rating and escaped note under the same adventure. Older unattributable rows are not assigned to a guessed person. Group codes are six alphanumeric characters. Trips can be explicitly shared with a group. Completed adventures allow date edits from 1900 through 2100.

On the world screen, Search all adventures is full-width. The world dot map is more detailed; country and continent browsing remain available. Near me and location lookup have been removed. The native Geolocation SDK and required purpose strings remain for compatibility, but this version does not request device location. A first-use tutorial can be skipped or replayed from Me and describes Me/Group, Back navigation and support.

New memory photos remain in app-private device storage and are never uploaded to Wayfinder, the company or groups. Photo rows scroll within their own cards. Me provides password-encrypted account-bound photo backup/export/import and optional Save photos to camera roll on the same iPhone. Copies saved to Photos are controlled by the user and may sync through their own iCloud settings.

The eight existing approved non-consumable hidden-gem collections remain individual-account purchases with Restore Purchases. Booking links are clearly labelled Paid link; Viator/provider bookings occur externally and are separate from gem purchases. Community accepts text only and recommendations await moderation before publication; reporting and blocking are available. Support, privacy and in-app account deletion remain accessible.

Public submission is authorised by the owner. Previous local/dummy-account checks do not substitute for physical-device Photos, StoreKit or installed-link acceptance.
